Solve \(2^n = \frac14 4^n\):

\[
2^n = \frac14 \cdot 2^{2n} = 2^{2n-2}
\]

So \(n=2n-2\), giving \(n=2\).

For \(\left(5x-\frac1x\right)^2\), the constant term occurs when the powers of \(x\) cancel:

\[
\binom{2}{1}(5x)^1\left(-\frac1x\right)^1 = 2\cdot 5\cdot(-1) = -10.
\]

\[
\boxed{-10}
\]
